items.title: Create Official Git Release Tag for v2608.47.0-as
items.details: Created official Git release tag (v2608.47.0-as) on GitHub marking the completion of Red Team Audit Rounds 22-24 and Generation 2608 Mode 2 refactoring.

items.title: Expand Framework Modules & Core Supplements
items.details: Drafted brand-new modular framework supplements expanding lore, blood sorcery, coven judicial protocols, and tactical equipment arsenals.

tasks.title: Draft Bloodline Magic Compendium Supplement
tasks.details: Drafted Bloodline Magic Compendium supplement (docs/2608/supplements/bloodline_magic.md) detailing Tier 1-3 blood rituals, incantation action economy, coven circle chants, and sacrificial upkeep.

tasks.title: Draft Coven Law Court Protocols & Legal Code
tasks.details: Drafted Coven Law Court Protocols & Legal Code supplement (docs/2608/supplements/coven_law_protocols.md) detailing 3-Magistrate tribunals, evidence admissibility, Sanctioned Termination decrees, and Sanctioned Release Dispensations.

tasks.title: Draft Equipment & UV Arsenal Handbook
tasks.details: Drafted Equipment & UV Arsenal Handbook supplement (docs/2608/supplements/uv_arsenal_handbook.md) cataloging hunter UV rifles, flashbangs, thermal FLIR masking suits, and Synth-Vitae plasma packs.

items.title: Generation 2608 Red Team Vulnerability Audits
items.details: Perform systematic Red Team vulnerability, edge-case, and contradiction audits on the Generation 2608 master ruleset document (docs/2608/vampire.md). Manages and tracks all version-scoped TODO tasks in .dev/2608/todo.json across Rounds 1-24+.

items.title: Red Team Audit — Bloodline Magic Compendium
items.details: Perform systematic Red Team vulnerability, edge-case, and contradiction audit on the Bloodline Magic Compendium supplement (docs/2608/supplements/bloodline_magic.md). Check ritual action economy balance, Blood Reserve cost interactions, coven circle stacking exploits, Tier 3 primordial rite overpowerment risks, and cross-supplement compatibility with vampire.md. Findings tracked as DOCS-57 through DOCS-71 in .dev/2608/todo.json.

items.title: Red Team Audit — Coven Law Court Protocols & Legal Code
items.details: Perform systematic Red Team vulnerability, edge-case, and contradiction audit on the Coven Law Court Protocols & Legal Code supplement (docs/2608/supplements/coven_law_protocols.md). Check tribunal vote manipulation exploits, Sanctioned Release Dispensation loopholes, Blood Treaty diplomatic edge-cases, evidence forgery counterplay, and punishment escalation gaps.

items.title: Red Team Audit — Equipment & UV Arsenal Handbook
items.details: Perform systematic Red Team vulnerability, edge-case, and contradiction audit on the Equipment & UV Arsenal Handbook supplement (docs/2608/supplements/uv_arsenal_handbook.md). Check UV weapon stacking interactions, Daywalker's Grace immunity edge-cases, Synth-Vitae vs living blood mechanical gaps, armor penetration cross-supplement interactions, and thermal suit vs FLIR counterplay balance.

items.title: Author Community & Editorial Guidelines (CONTRIBUTING.md)
items.details: Authored comprehensive CONTRIBUTING.md at the repository root detailing guidelines for community lore submissions, balance pull requests, Markdown formatting conventions, frontmatter schemas, micro-anchoring, and Red Team audit review workflows.

items.title: Setup GitHub Actions Markdown Link & Lint CI/CD Pipeline
items.details: Created GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow (.github/workflows/lint.yml) and automated audit script (.github/scripts/validate_workspace.py) to automatically validate internal anchor cross-references, verify frontmatter schemas, and lint Markdown syntax on every push and pull request to main.
